name: AI-Ready Design Systems
description: Curated, scored catalog of production-grade design systems for AI agents to choose from and build with.

rubric.label: Official MCP server (agent can query components/docs live)
llms-full.txt (whole docs as one markdown file)
Machine-readable design tokens in the repo
Typed component API (TypeScript / Swift / Kotlin / Dart / C#)
Registry / CLI install of component source (e.g. shadcn registry)
Agent instructions in the repo (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, cursor rules, skills)
Accessibility guidance shipped with the source

systems.name: assistant-ui
systems.bestFor: Production AI chat UIs in React with streaming, attachments and tool UIs.

systems.name: HeroUI (formerly NextUI)
systems.bestFor: Good-looking consumer and SaaS React apps on Tailwind with animations built in.

systems.name: shadcn/ui
systems.bestFor: Modern SaaS and AI apps on React/Next.js + Tailwind where you want to own and restyle component source.

systems.name: Mantine
systems.bestFor: Full-featured React apps needing 100+ components plus hooks, forms, dates, charts and notifications out of the box.

systems.name: Chakra UI
systems.bestFor: Accessible, themeable React apps with style props; fast to brand.

systems.name: Ark UI
systems.bestFor: Headless, state-machine-based components across React, Vue, Solid and Svelte.

systems.name: Nuxt UI
systems.bestFor: Vue / Nuxt SaaS and marketing sites on Tailwind, with templates and dashboard blocks.

systems.name: Material UI (MUI)
systems.bestFor: Feature-rich React apps and admin tools that benefit from Material Design and a huge component set (incl. MUI X data grid).

systems.name: React Spectrum / React Aria
systems.bestFor: Best-in-class accessibility and internationalisation; React Aria for custom-branded systems, Spectrum for Adobe-style tools.

systems.name: daisyUI
systems.bestFor: Framework-agnostic Tailwind component classes with many themes; great for quick MVPs in any stack.

systems.name: Tamagui
systems.bestFor: One React codebase shipping optimised UI to web, iOS and Android.

systems.name: Fluent UI
systems.bestFor: Productivity and enterprise apps, especially Microsoft 365 / Teams add-ins.

systems.name: React Native Paper
systems.bestFor: Material Design 3 apps in React Native.

systems.name: Ant Design
systems.bestFor: Data-dense enterprise and back-office apps (tables, forms, workflows) in React.

systems.name: Carbon Design System
systems.bestFor: Serious enterprise and data products with strict accessibility and a rigorous token system.

systems.name: Ionic Framework
systems.bestFor: Cross-platform mobile apps from one web codebase with iOS and Material styling.

systems.name: Primer
systems.bestFor: Developer tools and GitHub-like interfaces.

systems.name: Flutter Material 3
systems.bestFor: Default choice for Flutter apps: Material 3 widgets ship with the SDK.

systems.name: Primer Primitives (tokens)
systems.bestFor: Design tokens only: Primer colour, size and typography as CSS variables / JSON.

systems.name: Cloudscape
systems.bestFor: Cloud consoles, ops dashboards and data-heavy B2B tools (AWS console style).

systems.name: Blueprint
systems.bestFor: Complex, data-dense desktop-style web apps (analytics, ops tooling).

systems.name: Elastic UI (EUI)
systems.bestFor: Search, observability and analytics dashboards.

systems.name: CMS Design System
systems.org: U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services

systems.name: Salt Design System
systems.bestFor: Financial and trading apps with dense data and strict accessibility.

systems.name: Gravity UI
systems.bestFor: Internal tools, cloud consoles and dashboards; includes charts, navigation and date components.

systems.name: Material Design 3 for Android (Compose)
systems.bestFor: Native Android apps: Compose Material 3 is the platform default.

systems.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines + SwiftUI
systems.bestFor: Native iOS / macOS apps: SwiftUI system components follow the HIG for free.

systems.name: Vuetify
systems.bestFor: Material-style Vue apps with a very complete component set.

systems.name: Radix Primitives
systems.bestFor: Unstyled accessible primitives when you are building your own branded system.

systems.name: Radix Themes
systems.bestFor: Polished, accessible React UI with a clean default look and minimal setup.

systems.name: Atlassian Design System
systems.bestFor: Collaboration and work-management tools; Jira/Confluence apps.

systems.name: PatternFly
systems.bestFor: Enterprise and hybrid-cloud management consoles.

systems.name: AI Elements
systems.bestFor: Chat, agent and AI-assistant interfaces (messages, prompt input, reasoning, tool calls) on shadcn/ui + AI SDK.

systems.name: GOV.UK Design System
systems.bestFor: Public services and form-heavy transactional flows where accessibility and plain language matter most.

systems.name: Tremor
systems.bestFor: Dashboards and analytics UIs (charts, KPI cards) on React + Tailwind.
